architecture_patterns.pattern: Use `slashMenuItems` in `useCreateBlockNote` config. Define `execute(editor)` to perform actions.
Use `useProviderStore` to get active provider. Use `generateText` from specialized SDK or agent facade.
UI state (prompt open/closed) should be local or Zustand if complex.

research_notes.finding: Can insert blocks directly. To open a modal, the execute function can trigger a state change.
